Name: StardewValley_AI_Living_NPCs
Author: jojojoantoto
Description:
[size=4]What would happen if your favorite character was a real person?[/size]

Stardew Valley AI brings your favorite characters to life through the power of AI! Experience deeper connections as NPCs adapt their interactions based on your friendship level, just like real relationships evolve over time.

This mod uses AI to power up your relationships, bringing your friends, potential lovers, and companions alive in new and exciting ways! The mod displays morning messages from your highest friendship NPC, with plans to expand to more characters and interactions in the future.

[size=4]Latest Version[/size]
v1.3.0
- New Feature: NPC morning greetings are now more dynamic and context-aware, considering game progress (year, day, yesterday's earnings).

v1.2.0
- Improvement: Enhanced game language detection with support for multiple languages
- Supported languages: English, Chinese (中文), Japanese (日本語), Russian (Русский), Spanish (Español), Portuguese (Português), German (Deutsch), Thai (ไทย), French (Français), Korean (한국어), Italian (Italiano), Turkish (Türkçe), Hungarian (Magyar)
- Removed: Time pause feature

v1.1.0
- New Feature: Now shows morning messages from your highest friendship NPC, not just Sebastian
- Improvement: If multiple NPCs have the same highest friendship level, it rotates based on game day
- Fix: Fixed an issue where the displayed character was not synchronized with the API call

[size=4]Current Features[/size]
Morning Messages from Highest Friendship NPC
- Personalized Greetings: Every morning when leaving your farm, your highest friendship NPC will send you a greeting
- Friendship-Based Content: Messages change based on your friendship level with the NPC
- Smart Selection: Automatically selects your highest friendship NPC, and if multiple NPCs share the same level, it rotates daily
- AI-Generated: API integration provides natural and varied dialogue experiences
- Multi-language Support: Automatically detects and uses the current game language
- Supported languages: English, Chinese (中文), Japanese (日本語), Russian (Русский), Spanish (Español), Portuguese (Português), German (Deutsch), Thai (ไทย), French (Français), Korean (한국어), Italian (Italiano), Turkish (Türkçe), Hungarian (Magyar)

[size=4]Installation Instructions[/size]
Prerequisites
1. Stardew Valley game (latest version)
2. SMAPI (latest version)
Installation Steps
1. Make sure SMAPI is installed
2. Download StardewValley AI: Living NPCs mod
3. Extract the mod files to Stardew Valley's Mods folder
4. Start the game, the mod will automatically load and initialize
